title: docs: the `@objectstack/skills` install line `npm install --save-dev …` exits 1 in a pnpm-installed project (`edgesOut`), and five sites still print it as the only command
body:
**Filing gate ①: a documented command that fails, measured, with named locations.** `finding` class a. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat for the `content/docs/**` rows. The two `skills/**` rows are governed (Tier H) and belong to `domain:skills`, so triage splits them or routes them. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023), from #24905's upgrade walk (PR #24922, out-of-scope finding 3). ⛔ Not a claim. The lane is self-labelled under rule B; grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured (2026-10-20)

The walk scaffolded an app with `create-objectstack@17.7.0` and installed it with pnpm 10.28 on Node 22.22. In that app:
- `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p "require('@objectstack/spec/package.json').version")"` exited `1` with `npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`;
- `pnpm add -D` of the same spec succeeded and wrote `"@objectstack/skills": "18.0.0"`.

`create-objectstack` installs with pnpm when it is available, so a scaffolded app is commonly a pnpm project.

|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` (≈`:111`, the skills step) | devx |
| `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx` (≈`:32`) | devx |
| `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` (≈`:21`) | devx |
| `skills/README.md` (≈`:11`) | skills (Tier H) |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` (≈`:129`) | skills (Tier H) |
| `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx` | fixed in PR #24922 |

## Wanted

- Each site gives the install line for the project's own package manager: pnpm, npm and yarn, or one line plus the rule. PR #24922's spelling in `releases/v18/` is one precedent.
- Measured, not restated: run the line each site keeps in a pnpm-installed and an npm-installed scaffold.
- ⛔ No new gate.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open and closed, for "npm install --save-dev @objectstack/skills fails pnpm project edgesOut skills install command": 0 hits. #23788 (closed) is npm 10's `edgesOut` crash on lockfile-less installs in the release lane, which is a different site.

Dedupe words: skills npm install pnpm; @objectstack/skills save-dev; experimental_sync pnpm.
